basic_details.job_title: CSIR IHBT Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 12 Project Associate, Project Assistant and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The CSIR-Institute of Himalayan Bioresource Technology (CSIR-IHBT), Palampur, has scheduled Walk-in Interviews on 18 November 2026 (position codes 18001 to 18005) and 19 November 2026 (position codes 18006 to 18011), with the time given as 09.30 AM, at CSIR-IHBT, Palampur (H.P.) - 176 061. Candidates reporting after 10.00 AM will not be allowed to appear. The notice (Advertisement No. 18/2026) covers 12 temporary project positions: Project Associate PAT-I, Project Assistant-I (PA-I), Project Associate PAT-II, Project Assistant-II (PA-II), Project Assistant, Senior Research Fellow and Principal

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Application on the prescribed format with latest coloured passport size photo affixed (the form also asks for a cross-signed recent colour photograph). Self-attested photocopies of testimonials of age, educational qualifications, experience etc. Original certificates of testimonials; candidates who do not bring them will not be allowed to appear for interview. Self-attested copies of essential certificates; otherwise the applications will not be accepted. The application form asks for the position code and project number, personal and contact details, educational qualifications from 10th class onwards, subject area and dissertation, experience details, work experience in CSIR labs, list of publications, any national eligibility test qualification, category (SC/ST/OBC/PH), any blood relation working in CSIR-IHBT, and a signed declaration.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: The Selection Committee(s) may adopt the selection criterion at its own: either a direct interview, or an objective test (based on Multiple Choice Questions) followed by an interview on the same day. The number of selected candidates may vary from the advertised positions depending on performance during the selection process.

faq.question: Q1. When and where is the CSIR-IHBT walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are on 18 November 2026 (codes 18001 to 18005) and 19 November 2026 (codes 18006 to 18011) at 09.30 AM, at CSIR-IHBT, Palampur (H.P.). Candidates reporting after 10.00 AM will not be allowed to appear.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there under Advertisement No. 18/2026?
faq.answer: There are 12 positions in 11 position codes: 2 for Project Associate PAT-I (18001) and 1 each for the other ten codes.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Assistant-I (PA-I)?
faq.answer: For Project Assistant-I (PA-I), codes 18002 and 18010, the essential qualification is SSC/10th plus ITI. Qualifications for the other posts differ and are given in the posts table.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The limit is 35 years for Project Associate and Project Assistant posts and 40 years for Senior Research Fellow and Principal-PAT, counted as on 18.11.2026 (codes 18001 to 18005) or 19.11.2026 (codes 18006 to 18011). SC/ST/PwBD/Women get 5 years' relaxation and OBC get 3 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: Pay ranges from Rs. 18,000 per month for Project Assistant-I to Rs. 49,000 per month for Principal-PAT, consolidated. Project Associate PAT-I codes 18005 and 18006 get Rs. 31,000 or Rs. 25,000 depending on NET/GATE or equivalent qualification.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the stipend?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice prints each amount as "per month" plus HRA: 10% HRA for most codes and 9% HRA for codes 18007, 18008 and 18010.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Bring the application on the prescribed format with a latest coloured passport size photo, self-attested photocopies of age, educational qualification and experience testimonials, and the original certificates. Candidates without originals will not be allowed to appear.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: The Selection Committee may hold a direct interview, or an objective test based on Multiple Choice Questions followed by an interview on the same day. The number of selected candidates may differ from the advertised positions.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, or 06 years, whichever is earlier, and give no right or claim to regularisation at CSIR or CSIR-IHBT.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one position code, and is travel allowance paid?
faq.answer: A candidate may apply for more than one position code but must submit a separate application form for each. No Travelling Allowance will be paid for attending the interview.
